run_markers_demo: run the mujoco-py markers demo that adds animated visual markers to a simulation viewer
load_model_from_xml: load a mujoco physics model from an XML string using load_model_from_xml
create_mjsim: create a MuJoCo simulation instance with MjSim from a loaded model
create_mjviewer: create a MuJoCo viewer instance with MjViewer to visualize the simulation
add_marker_to_viewer: add a visual-only marker to the MjViewer at a given position with a label
